summary.text: Michael Stender is the Republican incumbent, in office since June 5, 2023, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 108, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a former member of the Shikellamy School Board.

paragraphs.text: Michael Stender lives in Sunbury, Pennsylvania, and graduated from Shikellamy High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Bloomsburg University of Pennsylvania in 2009.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as a firefighter with the City of Harrisburg, legislative director of the Pennsylvania Professional Fire Fighters Association, EMS system coordinator with the Susquehanna EHS Council, and EMT with the Americus Hose Company.

Stender served on the Shikellamy School District board from 2022 to 2023, and Ballotpedia says he has also served on the board of the Pennsylvania Municipal Retirement System and the board of the Degenstein Community Library.
He assumed office in the state House on June 5, 2023, succeeding Lynda Schlegel Culver.
